fact: With FSRP support, Togo's national meteorological agency ANAMET has had a satellite image receiving antenna installed, giving it access to high-quality satellite data for its forecasting models and the agro-hydro-climatic forecasts it prepares for farmers each rainy season.
title: Togo/access to agro-hydrometeorological data: a new weather station installed with the support of the FSRP
